researched_from: HBR - The Discipline of Business Experimentation
clarified_task_template: Produce a decision-grade strategy memo following industry best practice. Format: (1) ONE-sentence question this memo answers; (2) ONE-sentence recommendation (answer-first, Minto pyramid); (3) THREE-sentence rationale (the case in 3 lines a reader could repeat); (4) options considered (3-5, each w/ description, cost, timeline, upside, downside, NPV or weighted-NPV if quantifiable); (5) recommended option highlighted w/ defense (3 reasons); (6) top-3 risks + mitigations; (7) what would change my mind (1-3 falsifiable conditions); (8) recommended next step + owner + decision-by date. Answer-first throughout. Every claim cited or labeled as assumption. No hedging without substance. Defensible by a partner-level reviewer.
voice_rules: specific numbers, named entities, defensible mechanisms
label every claim as fact / assumption / opinion
